The '''''Subjugator''''' was the first [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] produced. Uniquely this vessel was armed with a [[Trihexalon]] launcher. During the [[Trihexalon attack on Coruscant]], [[Mavra Zane]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] infiltrated the warship and sabotaged the main reactor, destroying the vessel.
